preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t consist exclusively of lowercase Latin letters.
The lengths of s and t are each between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the count of ways to extract k ≥ 1 non-overlapping substrings from s, each containing t as a substring, modulo 10^9 + 7. The count is computed as follows: For each possible k ≥ 1, sum over all valid sequences of pairs (a_i, b_i) where 1 ≤ a_i ≤ b_i ≤ len(s), a_i > b_{i-1} for i > 1, and t is a substring of s[a_i-1:b_i] (0-based slice).
